summary.text: Chance Henry is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 42, representing Acadia and Lafayette, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Chance Henry's occupation as Insurance Agency Owner.

The House member page lists Chance Henry's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development; Insurance; Ways and Means; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
